weighingControl.sourceMeaning: Ball weighing is a formal periodic control process, not a theoretical assumption.

researchHypothesis.description: Because the 100,000 number balls were manufactured/delivered in five sequential 20,000-number batches, any real batch-level manufacturing drift in mass, diameter, balance or finishing would be mechanically correlated with number ranges. This is a legitimate pre-draw hypothesis only if actual batch measurements or accepted/rejected batch evidence can be recovered.
researchHypothesis.whyItMatters: The 2026 draw is a new physical era. Ball-specific historical patterns from the approximately 20-year-old prior set must not be transferred to 2026.
